title: Input-length coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $0$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its input-length counter $N$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.N$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the input-length
coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.N$.
